summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Agroz Inc., a foreign private issuer, to disclose that it will not file its annual report on Form 20-F by the extended due date under Rule 12b-25. The filing cites delays in reviewing and compiling financial information needed to finalize audited statements. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a routine SEC notification regarding a late annual report and does not present an actionable event.
